title: 第19章 先秦炼气两千年！世人误闯天家！
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
闭关在即，他转身踏空，奔赴千里之外的淮南故地。

    千年岁月冲刷洗荡，昔日骇人听闻的百里死域，早已物是人非。

    当年漆黑坚硬的焦黑晶体，早已被黄土草木掩埋，荒芜旧城之上，烟火重燃，百姓安居，岁岁生息。

    世间无人知晓，这片平和土地之下，曾爆发过撼动天地的仙途之争，曾葬送大汉最精锐的铁骑与名将。

    史书刻意讳莫如深，民间传说尽数湮灭，当年令一代帝王寝食难安的惊天异象，早已沦为岁月中微不足道的尘埃。

    唯有地底深处的淮南王古墓，历经千年风雨依旧沉寂如初。

    昔日布下的逆天秘阵未曾彻底消散，残存的大道戾气与天命枷锁，萦绕墓穴千载不散。

    顾长青缓步走入古墓，尘封千年的石门无声开合，死寂的墓穴之中，灵气与戾气交织翻涌，扑面而来。

    他心中通透，自己千年卡在金丹巅峰，从非修为不足、道基不稳，而是天命刻意压制。

    五百年前，他冲击元婴失败，引动天道震怒，立下锁仙禁令，自此凡俗修士，再难踏足元婴之境，这是天地既定的铁律，无人可破。

    若是循常规闭关渡劫，只会被天道反噬，落得身死道消的结局。

    唯有借助运转了两千年的逆天大阵，承接当年未散的天道劫力，以两千年苦修道基为盾，以自身神魂性命为薪火，逆斩天命枷锁，方能搏出一线生机。

    这早已不是单纯的修行突破，而是以凡躯抗天道，以性命搏天命。

    古墓幽深寂静，阴风习习，千年尘埃轻落衣袍。

    顾长青静立阵眼中央，抬眼望向冥冥苍天，眼底无半分惧色，只剩阅尽千载沧桑的极致决然。

    两千年浮生大梦，看尽王朝倾覆、人间别离、众生浮沉，他早已勘破生死，无所畏惧。

    今日，他重入淮南旧墓，以一身修为、千载道行、无尽光阴为赌注，直面天道，死战元婴，逆命破局！

    顾长青闭死关，冲击元婴境。

    轰隆一声巨响！

    大阵石门关闭！

    顾长青再也没有踏出一步！

    生死皆浮尘！

    一心问鼎元婴之境！

    成！

    成为此界唯一真仙！

    败！

    则尘归尘土归土，身死道消！

    沧海桑田。

    转瞬间又是五百年。

    世间已变了颜色。

    明朝消亡了。

    清朝陨灭了。

    新时代到来。

    2026年，5月10号。

    抖音，短剧大行其道。

    一档探秘节目，横空出世。

    “观众朋友们，大家好！这里是国家文物局与央视联合为您带来的大型考古纪实直播节目——《探秘千年》。”

    “我是主持人冰冰。此刻，我们正位于淮南市郊外的一片特殊区域。相信很多观众朋友已经通过我们前期的宣传片有所了解，这片区域在历史上被记载为‘淮南古死域’。”

    央视直播间内，主持人冰冰声音清亮，面带微笑，但眼神中却透着难以掩盖的凝重。

    她身后的巨大屏幕上，正实时播放着无人机从高空俯瞰的景象。
content_en:
As he was about to retreat, he turned around and rushed to his hometown in Huainan, thousands of miles away.

    After thousands of years of erosion and destruction, the once appalling Hundred Miles of Death Zone has long since changed.

    The dark and hard charred crystals of the past have long been buried by loess and vegetation. Above the desolate old city, fireworks are rekindled, and the people live in peace and contentment year after year.

    No one in the world knows that under this peaceful land, a battle for the Immortal Path that shook the world once broke out and destroyed the most elite cavalry and famous generals of the Han Dynasty.

    History books deliberately kept the story secret, and folk legends were completely wiped out. The shocking vision that made a generation of emperors sleepless and uneasy has long been reduced to insignificant dust in the years.

    Only the ancient tomb of King Huainan deep underground remains as silent as ever after thousands of years of wind and rain.

    The heaven-defying secret formation deployed in the past has not completely dissipated, and the remaining violent energy of the avenue and the shackles of destiny will linger in the tomb for thousands of years.

    Gu Changqing walked slowly into the ancient tomb. The stone door that had been covered with dust for thousands of years opened and closed silently. In the dead silence of the tomb, spiritual energy and violent energy intertwined and surged towards his face.

    He knew clearly in his heart that he had been stuck at the peak of the Golden Core for thousands of years. It was not because of insufficient cultivation or unstable Dao foundation, but because he was deliberately suppressed by destiny.

    Five hundred years ago, he failed to attack the Nascent Soul, which aroused the anger of Heaven and imposed a ban on immortality. Since then, it has been difficult for ordinary monks to set foot in the realm of Nascent Soul. This is an established iron law of heaven and earth, and no one can break it.

    If you follow the routine and go into seclusion to survive the tribulation, you will only be counterattacked by the law of heaven, and you will end up with the death of your body and the disappearance of the law.

    Only by relying on the heaven-defying formation that has been operating for two thousand years, taking over the undissipated catastrophic power of heaven, using the foundation of two thousand years of ascetic cultivation as a shield, and using one's own soul and life as fuel to reverse the shackles of destiny, can we fight for a glimmer of hope.

    This is no longer a simple breakthrough in cultivation, but a mortal body fighting against the will of heaven, and a life fighting against the destiny of heaven.

    The ancient tomb is deep and quiet, the wind is blowing, and the thousands of years of dust gently fall off the clothes.

    Gu Changqing stood quietly in the center of the formation, raising his eyes to look at the dark sky. There was no trace of fear in his eyes, only the ultimate determination that had gone through thousands of years of vicissitudes.

    After two thousand years of dreaming, he has seen the overthrow of dynasties, the separation of the world, and the ups and downs of all sentient beings. He has already discovered life and death, and is fearless.

    Today, he re-entered the old tomb in Huainan, betting his cultivation, thousands of years of Taoism, and endless time, facing the way of heaven, fighting to the death against Nascent Soul, and defeating the fate!

    Gu Changqing went into seclusion and entered the Nascent Soul Realm.

    There was a loud bang!

    The stone gate of the formation is closed!

    Gu Changqing never took another step!

    Life and death are all dust!

    Dedicated to achieving the realm of Nascent Soul!

    become!

    Become the only true immortal in this world!

    defeat!

    Then dust will return to dust and dust will return to earth, and the body will die and the Tao will disappear!

    Changes in the sea.

    In a blink of an eye, it is another five hundred years.

    The world has changed color.

    The Ming Dynasty died.

    The Qing Dynasty fell.

    A new era has arrived.

    May 10, 2026.

    On Douyin, short plays are very popular.

    A mystery program was born out of nowhere.

    "Hello, viewers! This is a large-scale archaeological documentary live program jointly brought to you by the State Administration of Cultural Heritage and CCTV - "A Thousand Years of Exploration"."

    "I am the host Bingbing. At this moment, we are located in a special area on the outskirts of Huainan City. I believe many viewers have already learned about it through our early promotional videos. This area has been recorded in history as the 'Huainan Ancient Dead Area'."

    In the CCTV live broadcast room, the host Bingbing had a clear voice and a smile, but there was an unconcealable solemnity in her eyes.

    On the huge screen behind her, a drone view from a high altitude was being played in real time.
title_en: Chapter 19 Two thousand years of pre-Qin Qi refining! People in the world mistakenly enter the heavenly home!
